## [Left Page - Entry No. 29]

### No. 29. Molony to Gleeson

**Regd. 26 Jany 1918 @ 50 ms aft 12 o'c**

**To the Registrar of Deeds in Ireland**
A Memorial of an Indenture of Release made the tenth day of January one thousand nine hundred and eighteen Between Jeremiah Molony of Ballymacamore Croom in the County of Limerick farmer of the one part and Margaret Gleeson of Main Street Croom in the County of Limerick Widow of the other part whereby after reciting as therein It was witnessed that for the considerations therein the said Jeremiah Molony as Mortgagee did thereby grant unto the said Margaret Gleeson her heirs and assigns All that and those the lands hereditaments and premises expressed to be granted by the therein recited Indenture of Mortgage of the thirteenth day of June one thousand nine hundred and eleven viz dwelling house with offices as the same thereof situate in the Main Street of Croom and the strip of ground extending to the River Maigue being being part of the lands of Skamerrygare with the gardens of Crooms and Shanacloon situate in the Barony

## [Right Page - Entry No. 30]

### No. 30. M'Coy to M'Coy & anr

**Regd 26 Jany 1918 @ 53 ms aft 12 oc**

**To the Registrar of Deeds in Ireland**
A Memorial of an Indenture dated 4th October 1917 Between Thomas M'Coy of Rudergan in the County of Tyrone farmer of the one part and Thomas M'Coy Junior of same place his son of the other part whereby It Was Witnessed that said Thomas M'Coy as Beneficial Owner thereby Conveyed to said Thomas M'Coy Junr a farm of land in the townland of Rudergan in the Barony of East Omagh and County of Tyrone containing about 34.0.22 then in occupation of said Thomas M'Coy as tenant from year to year under Earl Belmore as a yearly rent of £ 9.2.0 To Hold same from and after the death of said Thomas M'Coy to said Thomas M'Coy Junior for the estate and interest of said Thomas M'Coy therein and said Thomas M'Coy Covenanted with said Thomas M'Coy Junior to pay the yearly rent and outgoings as they accrued due and not to permit or suffer said premises to be evicted for non payment of rent and Said Indenture witnessed as therein and it was thereby declared that it should be lawful for said Thomas M'Coy at anytime or times within 2 years from the date thereof by Deed or Deeds under his hand and Seal to revoke memorializing Deed or any part thereof Which said Indenture as to the execution thereof by said Thomas M'Coy and Thomas M'Coy Junior is witnessed by King Houston of Omagh in the County of Tyrone Solicitor and James Browne of Kelcam in said County farmer and this memorial as to the execution thereof by said Thomas M'Coy is witnessed by said King Houston and James Browne Thomas M'Coy (seal) Signed and Sealed by said Thomas M'Coy (in presence of (first truly read & explained to him by King Houston before he put his mark thereto King Houston James Browne The before named King Houston maketh Oath and Saith that he is a Subscribing witness to the Deed of which the foregoing writing is a memorial and also to said memorial that he was present and saw said Deed and memorial respectively duly executed by said Thomas M'Coy and that the name King Houston Subscribed as a witness to said Deed and memorial respectively is this Deponents proper name and handwriting King Houston Sworn at Omagh in the County of Tyrone this 14th day of January 1918 and I know deponent Before me a Justice of the Peace for said County Chas M Hamilton
